findings.claim: Script runs with `set -uo pipefail` (no -e) and this line has no `|| fail`. If componentizing the tick HAL fails, compose silently reuses a hal-tick.wasm left in the persistent $OUT from an earlier run: the same stale-artifact failure this PR claims to close.

findings.quoted_line: print(f"  -> the wake FIRED after {elapsed} poll(s) — the timer path WORKS end to end")
findings.claim: The 'timer path WORKS end to end' verdict is printed whenever elapsed != 0, without checking bits 0-5. It prints even if the negative control (bit4) or spawn/armed bits FAIL, and the script exits 0 either way, so a broken run can still report success.

findings.quoted_line: [ -e "$stale" ] && fail "stale stub artifact in the tick crate's target dir: $stale — remove it"
findings.claim: AFD-049 says this refusal is negative-controlled (rc=1 with the stale file, rc=0 without), but the PR adds no test or CI step that exercises it. That control was a manual one-off and nothing re-proves it.
